Previous reports revealed that WhatsApp is developing a brand-new chat theme feature, and this feature has now been officially rolled out to iPhone users. Here are the details.

WhatsApp's new chat themes feature dynamic backgrounds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is currently rolling out chat themes in five major categories, including Featured, Nature, Dynamic, Minimalist, and Doodle. As early as two weeks ago, the website had already discovered clues about the new theme series from the codebase.

The website stated that the "Featured" category contains "the best themes carefully selected by the WhatsApp design team"; the "Nature" category "brings outdoor scenery into the chat interface"; the "Dynamic" category offers "wallpapers that slowly move in the background"; the "Minimalist" theme "pairs the chat interface with a solid color background: white in light mode and black in dark mode"; as for "Doodle," it includes WhatsApp's classic wallpapers featuring doodle patterns.

Below is WABetaInfo's introduction to the "Dynamic" wallpapers, which can be considered the most noteworthy feature this time:

WABetaInfo stated that WhatsApp will automatically match the chat bubble colors based on the selected theme, and added that, as is WhatsApp's usual practice, the new feature may not be immediately available to all users.
